notes: INSIDE half of the Kett Chitin Thrower: a magazine of spines racked like a comb; the racks fill with amber spines as it charges (frame 5 = full, cells green), two crank stations, power coupling, hatch. fire: the magazine flashes and empties. damaged: the comb cracked, a spine jammed crooked, cells dead; disabled: spines scattered, the comb split. Barrel layer kett_chitin_thrower_barrel: a grown chitin horn flaring into a spined mouth with two grips; fire: a cone of needles leaves it.
